2607.20058.title: Reading and Steering Representations of Materials-Science Mechanisms in an Open-Weight Language Model
2607.20058.paper_summary: Large language models can answer scientific questions, yet a correct output does not reveal whether the model represents or uses the governing physics. Here we show that materials science mechanism information in the open-weight google/gemma-4-E4B-it model has three experimentally separable forms: concepts are readable in individual hidden states, constitutive orientation is carried by controlled transformations between states, and selected internal representations causally control engineering answers. We combine matched direct and Jacobian vocabulary readouts, option-free state geometry, a 60-law counterfactual benchmark and causal interventions. In 50 held-out materials descriptions, three independently fitted Jacobian lenses reproduced concept ranks, and target-free word sets from both readouts enabled blinded identification of 9 of 10 mechanism families. A separate 72-prompt benchmark produced mechanism-specific hidden-state neighborhoods, but an exact graph audit showed that this apparent physical organization was equally explained by numerical comparison. We therefore compared otherwise identical prompts in which only the direction of the physical input was reversed, asking whether the resulting hidden-state movement followed the supplied constitutive law. These state transformations ordered direct, physically neutral and inverse laws across 60 frozen relations and correctly oriented 39 of 40 directional laws, whereas lexical controls were near chance. Bidirectional interventions shifted answer probabilities toward or away from the physically appropriate outcome across all 12 matched cases, while counterfactual state patches transferred opposing decision signals across mechanisms and answer formats. Physical relationships were therefore more visible in controlled state changes than in absolute states alone.
2607.20058.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以回答科學問題，但正確的輸出並不揭示模型是否表示或使用了支配物理學的原理。在這裡，我們展示了開放權重的google/gemma-4-E4B-it模型中的材料科學機制信息具有三種可實驗分離的形式：概念在個別隱藏狀態中是可讀的，構成取向由狀態之間的受控轉換承載，選定的內部表徵因果地控制工程答案。我們結合了匹配的直接和雅可比詞彙讀出、無選項的狀態幾何、60條法律的反事實基準和因果干預。在50個保留的材料描述中，三個獨立擬合的雅可比透鏡再現了概念排名，來自兩個讀出的無目標詞集使得盲目識別10個機制家族中的9個成為可能。一個單獨的72提示基準產生了機制特定的隱藏狀態鄰域，但精確的圖形審計顯示，這種表面上的物理組織同樣可以通過數值比較來解釋。因此，我們比較了在其他方面相同的提示，僅僅是物理輸入的方向被反轉，詢問結果隱藏狀態的運動是否遵循所提供的構成法則。這些狀態轉換在60個凍結關係中對直接、物理中立和逆向法則進行了排序，並正確地定向了40個方向法則中的39個，而詞彙控制接近隨機。雙向干預在所有12個匹配案例中將答案概率向物理上合適的結果轉移或遠離，而反事實狀態區域則在機制和答案格式之間轉移了相反的決策信號。因此，物理關係在受控狀態變化中比在絕對狀態中更為明顯。
2607.20058.author: Markus J. Buehler et.al.
